Apple Singh, Andheri Honest Review (and why I’m never going back to Apple Authorised Care)
Let me tell you something that genuinely shocked me.
My left AirPods Pro 2 stopped charging. Classic issue most of the time it’s oxidation or debris buildup on the charging contacts inside the case. Simple stuff. So I did what anyone would do and walked into an Authorised Apple Service Centre.
Big mistake.
After waiting in line, they told me to come back after 14 hours. Fine. I came back. Their diagnosis? “Your charging case needs to be replaced.” Cost: ₹13,000. And yes they charged me ₹1,500 just for that “diagnosis.” For a problem they clearly never even looked at properly.
Here’s the technical reality: AirPods Pro 2 use pogo-pin style charging contacts. These are notoriously prone to collecting earwax, dust, and moisture residue — especially in humid conditions. Nine times out of ten, a proper cleaning of the contact points with the right tools completely resolves charging failures. This is literally day-one Apple troubleshooting knowledge.
So I walked into Apple Singh, Andheri.
The technician took one look at my AirPods, identified the issue immediately, cleaned the charging contacts right in front of me no black box, no “come back tomorrow” and they started charging instantly.
Total cost: ₹0.
This isn’t just about money. It’s about the fact that an authorised centre was either too lazy to do a basic inspection or was actively trying to upsell a ₹13,000 case replacement on a problem that needed a cleaning tool and two minutes of time.
If you’re in Mumbai and having any Apple device issues Apple Singh, Andheri is where you go. Technically sharp, transparent, and they actually respect your time and your wallet.
